verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a managed API with US, EU, and Australia endpoints, plus in-VPC and self-hosted deployment, so users can pick where audio is processed or keep it in their own infrastructure. The evidence is a single summary line from llms.txt and does not say that data at rest stays in the chosen region. missing for 10: explicit data-at-rest residency guarantees per region, in-depth residency/configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
